C1743.title: AI-Generated Stefanie Sun Covers Spark Training Data Copyright Debate
C1743.summary: An online trend saw users employing model training and post-processing to create AI-generated covers mimicking singer Stefanie Sun's voice. Peking University professor Yi Jiming noted that training such AI requires extracting Sun's vocal characteristics and feeding it large volumes of song data, raising issues of authorization concerning the singer's voice rights and the copyrights of songwriters.

references.title: Difficulty in Data Ownership? Copyright Risks in Training AI on Sun Yanzi? Interview with Peking University Professor Yi Jiming
